overview_description.description: ClickUp is a cloud-based productivity and project management software company that provides an all-in-one platform for task management, team collaboration, documentation, workflow automation, and communication. The company develops tools designed to help organizations centralize work processes and improve operational efficiency across teams. Its platform integrates features such as project tracking, dashboards, calendars, whiteboards, chat, and AI-powered productivity tools to support businesses of various sizes and industries.

about_short_description.short_description: ClickUp is a cloud-based productivity and project management software company that provides an all-in-one platforms for task management.

product.name: ClickUp
product.description: A cloud-based work management platform for organizing tasks, projects, documents, conversations, goals, and workflows in one workspace.

product.name: ClickUp Brain
product.description: An AI workspace assistant that uses context from ClickUp tasks, documents, conversations, and connected applications to answer questions and assist with work.

product.name: ClickUp Super Agents
product.description: Configurable AI agents that perform recurring work across ClickUp workflows and connected tools, including task updates, assignments, information retrieval, and content generation.

product.name: ClickUp Projects
product.description: Project management functionality for planning, organizing, tracking, and reporting on projects using tasks, dependencies, milestones, custom workflows, and multiple views.

product.name: ClickUp Chat
product.description: An integrated team communication tool for direct messages, channels, threads, announcements, and calls, with conversations linked to tasks and project work.

product.name: ClickUp Docs & Wikis
product.description: Collaborative document and knowledge-management tools for creating documents, wikis, project requirements, procedures, and other structured team information.
